claims.property: Request budget derives from the handshake sequence; 18th CLI / 13th metadata request, out-of-order and pre-handshake trials refuse before transport
Explicit 5 s request timeout, wall cap, body caps and Sprintctl 0.20.0 refuse
Partial runs are incomplete with completed samples and complete event/window records; pre-network refusals are refused

Redirects never followed; refusals final and re-raised at trial end; repo, metadata-body, in-flight, message-count, CLI-exit and malformed-JSON guards each refuse with a bounded outcome; an interrupt after traffic (KeyboardInterrupt, real SIGINT cancelling the in-flight request in preflight or a CLI trial, or click's Abort raised from a KeyboardInterrupt; a bare or EOF Abort is not an interrupt) reports incomplete/interrupted with the in-flight request labelled interrupted; main exits 130 for that report

Each mode's exact profile binding (id, revision, source environment, endpoint, environment id, authorities) is checked before any request; the workstation maintenance profile and other mismatches refuse with zero requests and the credential is never read
No local state or bytecode writes by the collector, including the real Sprintctl 0.21.0 CLI path
Live cohort measurements, effective authority, EC-01 completion

counterexamples.summary: Live run with plan ed0709c3 used the workstation maintenance profile (workstation-vuoro-shared, no principal/workspace inbox) for served-cli-inbox-read and ended incomplete with 403 identity-unbound; the plan named no profile. Now refused locally as profile-binding-mismatch.

notes: Default scripts suite skips the 25 released-client tests; the separate 0.21.0 interpreter run is the released-client evidence.
The bytecode check failed when run() did not suppress bytecode writes (mutation check), so it is not vacuous.
Sprintctl module hashes in the plan match the published v0.21.0 wheel asset (sha256 30fa8b14…908d), confirmed in review.

Each review-requested guard (follow_redirects, final refusal, repo_id, metadata body, in-flight, message count, trial-end re-raise, refused/incomplete split, redirect history, interrupt, CLI exit code, decoder recursion, shape routing, non-object JSON) was mutated individually and a test failed every time.

Interrupt handling (cancellation relabel, cancelled label, cause/context chain walk, and a broadened any-Abort classification) was mutated individually and a test failed every time. The SIGINT tests raise a real signal in-process under the default handler; terminal Ctrl-C delivery itself is not exercised.

Profile check mutated per field (id, revision, source environment, endpoint, environment id, authorities), removed, moved after source bindings, and with the plan-shape check disabled: a test failed every time.
